Ad-funded article that opens a tab on any click

This fixture reproduces the pattern that motivated nip07-bridge.ts's window.open override: a capture-phase click listener on the document that calls window.open() for ANY click anywhere on the page — including clicks inside the Discerned overlay's shadow DOM, which the page can't see into but whose clicks still bubble up to window.

The listener is registered at page load, long before the extension is activated, exactly as a real ad script would be. The guard works by intercepting the window.open CALL, so it must be installed before the user's first click inside the overlay.
